id: title:Gilbert09:normalize time columns to seconds to stop schema oscillation

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion compatibility and schema reconciliation
review.reason: Adds helper and branch to convert warehouse-provided time64 columns to float64 seconds, preserving compatibility with stored double columns and avoiding schema reconciliation failures; also clarifies error behavior for incompatible casts.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual warehouse compatibility or recovery behavior; tier assigned based on bounded implementation and compatibility preservation rather than demonstrated systemic benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to convert datetime.time to float seconds.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports warehouse ingestion compatibility when SQL TIME columns arrive as Python timedelta or time64, preventing type oscillation between batches.
